english.title: Use / cause / permit vehicle to be used with insecure load at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

on a part of Bristol Airport to which the Road Traffic Enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), at a time when the load carried by the vehicle was not secured so that danger was caused or was likely to be caused to any person or property by reason of the load or any part thereof falling or being blown from the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6.10.2 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
